experiment: B1 forward, dual-softmax and MNN inference ablation
comparison: All modes are computed from the same checkpoint, batches, preprocessing, and temperature-scaled logits.

score_definitions.mnn: accept the row-argmax pair only when the selected satellite's column-argmax is the same front query; no dustbin
score_definitions.mnn_retention_score: forward-softmax probability of the accepted mutual pair; retention is ranked within accepted MNN pairs
score_definitions.mnn_unmatched: non-mutual queries receive index -1 and no coarse/refined match; counted as unmatched and as incorrect in all-query Top-1
score_definitions.temperature: L is already temperature/logit-scale adjusted; no extra scaling is applied.
score_definitions.dual_score_calibration: raw dual score, not a calibrated match-correctness probability.
score_definitions.invalid_positions: masked from both normalizations; reverse normalization uses every valid front query in each sample.
score_definitions.training: original row-wise cross entropy on unchanged logits; no reverse loss.
score_definitions.mnn_refinement: same dense refiner; unmatched queries are masked in its output and zero-filled as internal coarse-warp context

provenance.confidence_pairing_evidence: stored base path; legacy checkpoint has no historical hash

geometric_depth_diagnostic.prediction: camera-z recovered geometrically from the selected north-up satellite match and camera pose
geometric_depth_diagnostic.ground_truth: LiDAR camera-z sampled at front query positions

depth_evaluation.weights: same frozen learned confidence head, sampled at each stage/mode selected location
depth_evaluation.anchors: all inference-valid finite positive anchor camera-z <= max_anchor_depth_m and positive mono camera-z; no GT filtering or certainty/top-k gate
depth_evaluation.mask: same finite positive mono and configured LiDAR-depth mask for all modes; paired valid-scale frames per stage
depth_evaluation.coarse_note: coarse-stage ablation applies the same head trained on refined anchors at coarse positions

mnn.retention_population: accepted mutual MNN pairs; coverage is measured against all valid GT queries
